name: Qwen 3.5 35B
short: Alibaba's 35B-total/3B-active Qwen 3.5 open-weights MoE for cheap multimodal reasoning and coding; 262K native context, Apache 2.0, from ~$0.08/$0.75 per 1M.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: The 3B-active sweet spot: full multimodal reasoning and coding at price levels that make always-on agents viable.
tradeoff: Small-active depth — it handles breadth cheaply, not frontier difficulty.
